text: The Patriots are searching for their first win of the season against a rolling Steelers team this Sunday at Gillette Stadium, though they'll be doing so without receiver A.J. Brown, whose high ankle sprain will sideline him for the next four weeks following his Week 1 injury. On a brighter note, running back TreVeyon Henderson, who sat out the opener with an ankle injury, said Thursday he's "ready to go" for the Steelers matchup, giving the offense some reinforcement in the backfield. The team also made a practice squad move, signing offensive lineman Xavier Newman-Johnson while releasing Jacob Rizy, and will honor former All-Pro cornerback Stephon Gilmore on Friday when he returns to Foxborough to retire as a Patriot with a media address at 2:10 PM ET. Off the field, owner Robert Kraft confirmed he had Macklemore removed as an opening act for Ed Sheeran's upcoming shows at Gillette Stadium, citing what he described as the artist's "history of antisemitic rhetoric and imagery that we believe has been deeply offensive and hurtful to the Jewish community."
